svg.title: The champion reverses into the wall
svg.text: seed 3, gen 80 champion (it beat me by 13.93 s on Neon Loop), alone on Neon Loop Mirrored
yellow: it reaches the hairpin, which now turns right, at 330 px/s and brakes to a stop by 7.10 s
pink: it keeps holding BRAKE, which from a standstill means reverse,
and backs into the inner wall at 7.63 s
